content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a minor revision before we proceed. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms require performing unmentioned extra services without any change-order mechanism or additional compensation, so I propose that any additional services outside the scope of this Agreement shall be documented in a written change order and compensated at mutually agreed rates. Thank you for your time and cooperation.
